title: Weekend Warriors SMP
description: New Server!! Weekend Warriors SMP, built around progression, economy, quests, events, Skyblock, player tools, and community-focused systems. It combines custom plugins with tuned third-party tools to create a polished PvE/PvP
body:
Weekend Warriors SMP is a custom Minecraft survival server designed around long-term progression, community gameplay, and a polished survival experience. Players can explore the main SMP world, build bases, use homes and RTP, run Skyblock islands, complete quests, earn rewards, interact with a custom economy, and take part in server-wide events.

The server uses a large custom plugin suite to support player settings, markets, shards, auctions, upgraded tools, furnaces, hoppers, boosters, cosmetics, guide/onboarding systems, moderation, maintenance tools, and staff utilities. The goal is to make the server feel feature-rich and professional while still keeping the core survival loop easy to understand, rewarding, and fun to return to.

Port For Bedrock Players: 46064
